title: Counting Sort Arguments
statement: The counting-sort arguments consist of a number $n$ of items; source and destination locations; a key-field base, stride, and offset specifying where each item's key is stored; a bound $nb$ such that all keys are less than $nb$; and a base location $cnt$ for $nb+1$ scratch cells.
